svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: StockDesk risk matrix: likelihood x impact, as found, after the merge, after the admin actions
svg.desc: Three 5 by 5 matrices. Each risk ID sits in the cell of its likelihood (rows, 1 to 5) and impact (columns, 1 to 5). Cell colour is the level of the score likelihood x impact: tolerable 1-4, low 5-9, high 10-14, intolerable 15-25. The same data is in docs/RISK-PRIORITISATION.md as tables.
